verdict.rationale: Letta documents a default local mode that stores agent state, including memory, on your machine without a Letta login. Its self-hosting docs say all agent state stays on-device and that agents can run entirely on infrastructure you control, via a self-hosted App Server and a 'local' backend. However, no evidence shows local model inference (only API keys for providers like Claude, GPT and Gemini), and shared memory is hosted in Letta Cloud, so 'without any cloud dependency' is not shown end to end. Missing for 10: documented local/offline LLM support (e.g., Ollama or other local model providers), explicit embedded in-process memory backend for the SDK, a local alternative for shared memory, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully offline setup.
